text:
sam: claiming maint slot ms-1420 for cross-shard schema add + small backfill. start 2027-01-20T02:00:00Z, window=50m. runtime pin to v2.22.1. plan: leader-only DDL, canary on 2 tiny shards, then 3 waves.

deploybot: slot ms-1420 created. start=2027-01-20T02:00:00Z window=50m owner=@sam holdpoints=[preflight, canary-check] autopause=10m

julia: preflight checklist: staging smoke, schema-compat, sample pg_locks, replica health. canary targets = s-small-1/2, backfill-rate=700/s workers=5.

ira: quick abort criteria: replication_lag > 50s for 3m OR any deadlock >1 in 5m OR table-locks > 6s on >=2 nodes. add auto-abort if backfill errors >0.6% sustained 5m.

sam: ops rollback TLDR:
```
- stop backfill: `./tools/migctl stop --slot ms-1420`
- set write-block: `ffctl set tenant_schema_block true`
- unpin runtime: `infractl pin-service api v2.21.8`
- run revert DDL: `psql -f revert/ms-1420-undo.sql`
- notify: /msg #oncall "ms-1420 abort executed"
```

deploybot: holdpoint created: ms-1420.preflight. react with :white_check_mark: to proceed.

julia: preflight ok, smoke passed, locks low. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: canary wave started (wave=1/4) targets=[s-small-1,s-small-2] rate=700 workers=5

ira: watching replication and pg_locks snapshots every 30s. if unpin blocks later, fallback: flip routing to read-fallback and scale read replicas +1 for 6m.

deploybot: canary complete. metrics: errors=0.05% replication_peak=29s p99+3ms. vote CONTINUE or ABORT.

julia: +1 continue but keep canary-check holdpoint until T+10m observation.

sam: starting wave 2 now, spacing waves 7m apart. will lower batch size if lock contention appears.

deploybot: wave=2/4 started. queued=8 workers=6

ira: observed a 7s lock on shard-4 during wave 2; crossing soft guard. lowering next wave rate to 400 to reduce contention.

sam: acknowledged, adjusting batch size and capturing pg_locks snapshots to s3://redwood-runs/ms-1420/artifacts

deploybot: wave=3/4 started with adjusted rate=400. queued=6 workers=5

julia: replication peeked 46s but below abort threshold. continuing with caution.

ira: if replication crosses 55s auto-abort and run rollback steps. also terminate long backfill queries: `psql -c "SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE query ~ 'backfill' AND now()-query_start > interval '30 seconds'"`

sam: final wave starting now with conservative rate. will post final artifacts and release-note snippet after window closes.

deploybot: slot ms-1420 complete. status=success. aggregate errors=0.15% replication_peak=48s. deploybot.audit=ddb-4141590000. logs uploaded to s3://redwood-runs/ms-1420/.

julia: collecting post-run artifacts (pg_locks, backfill logs, replication timeline). will attach to the rollout ticket for follow-up tuning.

sam: thanks all — closing thread. :white_check_mark:
